extraction.notes: Press release on the EU Delegation site. It states that the chapter was provisionally closed but not what the amendments do or how the benchmark was met. The page links to the EU common position (AD 26/26); the link was not followed (LIM-0028) and nothing from that document is used here.

items.stated_text: At the 27 th meeting of the Accession Conference with Montenegro accession negotiations on chapters 2 ( freedom of movement for workers ) and 28 ( consumer and health protection ) were provisionally closed.
items.summary: Negotiations on Chapter 2 and Chapter 28 were provisionally closed at the 27th Accession Conference.

location.section: EU and Montenegro close accession negotiations on freedom of movement of workers and consumer and health protection

speaker.name_as_stated: Council of the EU presidency and European Commission (release on the EU Delegation to Montenegro site)

pass2.classification_note: implementation: chapter-level statement (G5 ruling): fits no single issue, so no issue assigned. Does not say what closed the benchmark (LIM-0028). A negotiating step, not an outcome in practice.
